positive: Create a project skill for the same missing workflow observed in two real tasks.
Repair a project skill whose routing and behavior evaluations prove a reusable gap.
near_negative: Create permanent instructions for a one-off request.
Add another skill when an installed skill already covers the capability.

behavior_assertions.assert: The proposal includes gap evidence, routing positives, near-negatives, and observable assertions.

behavior_assertions: Overlapping proposals collapse into one original bounded responsibility.
